headline: Philippines expects Canada free trade agreement to boost investment and exports
summary: Philippine Finance Secretary Frederick Go stated that the newly concluded free trade agreement with Canada will bolster investor confidence and expand Philippine export volumes.
why: Bilateral free trade agreements reduce tariffs and non-tariff barriers, facilitating foreign direct investment.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: The bilateral trade deal encourages Canadian foreign investment and Philippine goods exports.
